raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Motivation

Qwen-Image 2.1's FFN activation fast path (fused_silu_mul_bitexact) is gated on current_platform.is_cuda(). On ROCm that predicate is False (PlatformEnum.ROCM), so the optimization is dead code on AMD hardware — even though the fused kernel is plain Triton (no CUDA JIT / PTX) and reproduces the eager silu(a) * b chain bit-exactly on HIP.

This is the same situation the XPU port fixed in #41940, which enabled the identical kernel via (x.is_cuda or x.is_xpu). This PR does the equivalent for ROCm/HIP.

Modifications

python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/models/dits/qwen_image21.py:

  • Add _silu_mul_device = current_platform.is_cuda() or current_platform.is_hip().

  • Gate QwenImage21FeedForward.forward on _silu_mul_device instead of the vendor-pure _is_cuda.

Every other fast path in the module (RoPE, QK-norm, packed QKV, SDPA) stays CUDA-only, because those really are CUDA JIT / PTX kernels. The existing BitExactFusionGate still self-verifies the first call and permanently disables the path on any mismatch, so a platform that turns out not to be bit-exact falls back to eager instead of diverging.

python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_qwen_image21_silu_mul_fusion.py (new):

  • assert the guard tracks the CUDA-like device family;

  • assert fused_silu_mul_bitexact is bit-exact vs F.silu(a) * b at the FFN activation shapes.

Accuracy Tests

Environment: AMD Ryzen AI MAX 395 (Strix Halo), Radeon 8060S Graphics, gfx1151 (RDNA 3.5), torch 2.9.1+rocm7.2.4 (hip 7.2.53211), SGLang Diffusion, attention backend torch_sdpa.

  1. Kernel bit-exactness on gfx1151 — torch.equal(fused_silu_mul_bitexact(a, b), F.silu(a) * b):

    shape | max_abs_diff | bit-exact -- | -- | -- (1, 4096, 3072) | 0.000e+00 | yes (1, 2048, 3072) | 0.000e+00 | yes (1, 1024, 3072) | 0.000e+00 | yes (1, 4096, 2048) | 0.000e+00 | yes

    ON is faster in 2 of 3 pairs. The mean denoising delta (−1.0%) is within run-to-run noise at n=3 (per-run spread ≈1.5%), so the end-to-end figure should be read as no regression, small favorable trend. The deterministic part of the win is the kernel-level 1.67x; under --dit-layerwise-offload the FFN pointwise work partially overlaps weight prefetch, which masks most of it at this configuration.

    Checklist

    • Format your code according to the Format code with pre-commit.

    • Add unit tests according to the Run and add unit tests.

    • Update documentation according to Write documentations. (no doc change needed — no user-facing flag/behavior)

    • Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to Test the accuracy and Benchmark the speed.

    • Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

    Notes for reviewers

    • pre-commit run --files <two files> passes every hook (isort, ruff, ruff-format, codespell, check-chinese-characters, …).

    • Reproduced on a ROCm-only machine; on a CUDA machine the guard evaluates to True exactly as before, so NVIDIA behavior is unchanged.

    • Follow-ups (not in this PR): ideogram.py:_ideogram_swiglu uses the same kernel and is gated identically, and rmsnorm_preserve_reduction is pure Triton gated only on torch.version.hip is None.

files.patch:
@@ -61,6 +61,12 @@
 )
 
 _is_cuda = current_platform.is_cuda()
+# Every fast path below is a CUDA-only JIT or PTX kernel except the SiLU-mul
+# activation, which is plain Triton and rounds bit-exactly on HIP as well. That
+# one is gated on the device family instead of the vendor, so ROCm runs it too;
+# its BitExactFusionGate still verifies the first call and falls back on any
+# mismatch.
+_silu_mul_device = _is_cuda or current_platform.is_hip()
 
 logger = init_logger(__name__)
 _ROPE_FUSION = BitExactFusionGate("Qwen-Image 2.1 complex RoPE")
@@ -347,7 +353,7 @@ def forward(self, x):
         gate, value = self.gate_layer(x)[0], self.proj(x)[0]
         fused = None
         if (
-            _is_cuda
+            _silu_mul_device
             and gate.dtype is torch.bfloat16
             and _SILU_MUL_FUSION.can_attempt_once()
         ):

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Device guard and bit-exactness coverage for the Qwen-Image 2.1 SiLU-mul fusion.
+
+The fused activation is plain Triton, not a CUDA-only JIT/PTX kernel, so it is
+attempted on every CUDA-like device instead of NVIDIA hardware only. These tests
+pin the two facts that guard depends on: the guard itself tracks the device
+family, and the fused kernel still rounds bit-exactly against the eager
+``silu(a) * b`` chain it replaces.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import fused_silu_mul_bitexact
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits import qwen_image21 as model_module
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import current_platform
+
+
+class TestSiluMulFusionDeviceGuard(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_guard_tracks_the_cuda_like_device_family(self):
+        expected = current_platform.is_cuda() or current_platform.is_hip()
+        self.assertEqual(model_module._silu_mul_device, expected)
+        if torch.cuda.is_available():
+            self.assertTrue(
+                model_module._silu_mul_device,
+                "the fused SiLU-mul path is unreachable on a CUDA-like device",
+            )
+
+    @unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "requires a CUDA-like device")
+    def test_fused_silu_mul_is_bit_exact(self):
+        # The MLP widths Qwen-Image 2.1 actually feeds this kernel.
+        for shape in ((1, 2048, 3072), (1, 1024, 4096), (37, 1, 7)):
+            with self.subTest(shape=shape):
+                torch.manual_seed(0)
+                gate = torch.randn(*shape, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+                value = torch.randn(*shape, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    torch.equal(
+                        fused_silu_mul_bitexact(gate, value), F.silu(gate) * value
+                    )
+                )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
